src:
timeline title England's History Timeline section Stone Age 7600 BC : Britain's oldest known house was built in Orkney, Scotland 6000 BC : Sea levels rise and Britain becomes an island.
The people who live here are hunter-gatherers. section Bronze Age 2300 BC : People arrive from Europe and settle in Britain.
They bring farming and metalworking. : New styles of pottery and ways of burying the dead appear. 2200 BC : The last major building works are completed at Stonehenge.
People now bury their dead in stone circles. : The first metal objects are made in Britain.Some other nice things happen. it is a good time to be alive.

timeline title England's History Timeline section n Stone Age 7600 BC : Britain's oldest known house was built in Orkney, Scotland 6000 BC : Sea levels rise and Britain becomes an island.
The people who live here are hunter-gatherers. section Bronze Age 2300 BC : People arrive from Europe and settle in Britain.
They bring farming and metalworking. : New styles of potterctiony and ways of burying the dead appear. 2200 BC : The last major building works are completed at Stonehenge.
People now bury their dead in Section stone circles. : The first metal objects are made in Britain.Some other nice things happen. it is a good time to be alive.

src:
timeline title England's History Timeline section Stone Age 7600 BC : Britain's oldest known house was built in Orkney, Scotland 6000 BC : Sea levels rise and Britain becomes an island.

timeline title England's History Timeline section Stone Age 7600 BC : Britain's oldest known house was built in Orkney, Scotland 6000 BC : Sea levels rise and Britain becomes an island.
The people who live here are hunter-gatherers. section Bronze Age 2300 BC : People arrive from Europe and settle in Britain.
They bring farming and metalworking. : New styles of pottery and ways of burying the dead appear. 2200 BC : The last major building works areaccDescr: completed xt Stonehenge.
People now bury their dead in stone circles. : The first metal objects are made in Britain.Some other nice things happen. it is a good time to be alive.
